integrity: The claim is supported by a self-contained analytic proof, an arithmetic consistency script, and statement-level comparison with the accessible primary and related literature. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to real scalars and the two-dimensional space \(\ell_4^2\).
It determines only the exponent-matched generalized rectangular constant \(\mu_4\), not the classical rectangular constant or the general \(\mu_p(\ell_p)\) problem.

The 1970 Gastinel--Joly source remains a residual bibliographic risk because its full text was not available in the inspected public sources; the 2021 primary source describes it and still states that exact generalized values are in general unknown.
title: Exact generalized rectangular constant of the real \(\ell_4^2\) plane
